title: 💰GHO Grants
tagline: Project contributions are hard to track and the actual ways DAOs have to reward contributors are not efficient.  Our product aims at distributing a treasury of GHO tokens to project contributors, by checking deliverable quality.
description:
DAO-Ghorants: Streamlining Transparent Grant Processes with ChatGPT
DAO-Ghorants is a project dedicated to enhancing the grant processes within Decentralized Autonomous Organizations (DAOs). By leveraging blockchain technology and incorporating ChatGPT, this platform allows DAOs to seamlessly create, evaluate, and distribute funds transparently.

Features
Automated Grant Submissions: Simplify the grant submission process by automating various steps, making it easy for applicants to submit proposals.

Transparent Evaluation: Utilize smart contract-based criteria and integrate ChatGPT for transparent evaluation of grant proposals. This ensures a fair and decentralized decision-making process.

Efficient Fund Distributions: Upon approval, execute seamless fund distributions using blockchain technology, enhancing efficiency and transparency in fund management.

Grant Submission with Github Integration:
The platform introduces a seamless grant submission form with Github login integration. Only Github repositories from authenticated users can be submitted, ensuring authenticity and transparency in project submissions.

ChatGPT Evaluation:
Harness the power of ChatGPT for comprehensive project evaluations. The platform poses key questions in the evaluation process, covering critical aspects such as creativity, use of blockchain, impact on social good, collaboration opportunities, and project reliability.
how_its_made:
TypeScript/Node:
Primary development stack for server-side logic and enhanced code maintainability.

Solidity for Smart Contracts:
Deployed a ProposalManager.sol contract that creates a proposal, stores funds, accept a proposal and distribute funds to grant winners.

GitHub Sign-in Integration:
Authenticates users via GitHub, linking grant proposals directly to GitHub identities.

ChatGPT (OpenAI):
Integrated for human-like project evaluations, covering key aspects like creativity, use of blockchain, impact, collaboration, and reliability.
